name: petrichor
description: Procedural ambient/lo-fi music generator driven by time of day, live weather, and interaction activity.

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "cd server && cross-env PORT=3001 npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
scripts.build: npm run install:all && cd client && npm run build
scripts.test: cd server && npm run test && cd ../client && npm run test
